Single coherent specific scene, large readable figures and natural hands, no panels, no labels, writing, numerals, logos or watermark. Inside the instrument repair workshop, Biel is holding a small generic audio recorder above an otherwise bare wooden workbench, with its display turned away. Elies is leaning forward and observing it attentively, palms open as they discuss how to set it down. Softly suggested instruments in the background establish the setting.
